theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_rim_imrep_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), R₁.carrier ⊆ R.carrier → R₂.carrier ⊆ R.carrier → R₁.orient = R.orient → R₂.orient = R.orient → (∀ x ∈ R.carrier, R.mult x = R₁.carrier.indicator R₁.mult x + R₂.carrier.indicator R₂.mult x) → R.measure = R₁.measure + R₂.measure ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = R₁.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + R₂.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
